## What changes / 改动内容

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for the change.

## Validation / 验证

List commands and results. Distinguish automated tests from live Codex/UI checks.

## Checklist / 检查项

- [ ] The change is scoped; unrelated cleanup is excluded.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and documentation is updated in both languages where applicable.
- [ ] No private conversations, logs, caches, credentials, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Metric/protocol changes preserve unknown values and document their assumptions.
